business_problem: But modern football is no longer defined by performance on the pitch alone. Expectations from fans, partners, and internal stakeholders continue to rise—while budgets and headcount cannot scale indefinitely.
solution_summary: But modern football is no longer defined by performance on the pitch alone. Expectations from fans, partners, and internal stakeholders continue to rise—while budgets and headcount cannot scale indefinitely. At VfL Wolfsburg, football is built on discipline, continuity, and trust. For nearly three decades, the club has been a constant presence in the Bundesliga—backed by strong men’s and women’s teams, a future-oriented academy, and a fast-evolving digital and commercial ecosystem. External agencies handled routine work, but at high cost and without building internal capability Over the previous year, the club had already built meaningful experience with Generative AI, working with ChatGPT Team and Business licenses.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides a governed assistant environment for employees working across the deployment’s core workflows.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Team
solution_components.role: Gives teams a shared workspace for collaborative AI-assisted work.

solution_components.name: custom GPTs
solution_components.role: Package prompts, instructions, and curated context for repeatable internal tasks.
